def solve(g):
    from collections import Counter as Ct
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    c=Ct(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    rare=[c_ for c_,v in c.items() if v>2 and c_[c_] != 0]
    rare=[x for x in c if x!=0 and x!=bg and c[x]<H*W/3]
    rare=sorted(rare)
    seen=set()
    for cc in rare:
        o=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==cc]
        if not o: continue
        rs=[p[0] for p in o]; cs_=[p[1] for p in o]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs_),max(cs_)
        ch,ch_=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
        # paint D2-closed copies of existing cells within bbox, skipping non-bg
        paints=set()
        for i in range(r0,r1+1):
            for j in range(c0,c1+1):
                if g[i][j]==cc:
                    for pi,pj in [(i,j),(r0+r1-i,j),(i,c0+c1-j),(r0+r1-i,c0+c1-j)]:
                        if 0<=pi<H and 0<=pj<W and g[pi][pj]==bg:
                            paints.add((pi,pj))
        for pi,pj in paints:
            out[pi][pj]=cc
    return out

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Ct(x for r in g for x in r)
    bgc,_=cnt.most_common(1)[0]
    others={c:v for c,v in cnt.items() if c!=bgc}
    frame=max(others.values()) if others else None
    rare=[c for c,v in others.items() if v<=0.1*frame]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for cc in rare:
        pts=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==cc]
        rs=sorted(set(p[0] for p in pts)); cs=sorted(set(p[1] for p in pts))
        if len(rs)==2 and len(cs)==2:
            r0,r1,c0,c1=rs[0],rs[1],cs[0],cs[1]
            for j in range(c0,c1+1):
                if g[r0][j]==0: out[r0][j]=cc
                if g[r1][j]==0: out[r1][j]=cc
            for i in range(r0,r1+1):
                if g[i][c0]==0: out[i][c0]=cc
                if g[i][c1]==0: out[i][c1]=cc
    return out
for p in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    print(p, solve(G[p+' input'])==G[p+' output'])

print(json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])))

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Ct(x for r in g for x in r)
    bgc,_=cnt.most_common(1)[0]
    others={c:v for c,v in cnt.items() if c!=bgc}
    # rarest colors (ties resolved jointly): those below the max
    mx=max(others.values())
    rare=[c for c,v in others.items() if v<mx or (v==mx and True)]
    # exclude the dominant non-bg structure: keep only the truly rare marker colors = those with strictly fewer cells than the tile-frame
    # frame color = the non-bg color whose cells form the largest contiguous structures / highest count among multi-cell objects
    frame=max(others,key=lambda c:{x for x in [cnt[c]]})
    rare=[c for c,v in others.items() if v<cnt[[c for c,v in others.items() if v==max(others.values())][0]]]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for cc in rare:
        pts=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==cc]
        rs=sorted(set(p[0] for p in pts)); cs=sorted(set(p[1] for p in pts))
        if len(rs)==2 and len(cs)==2:
            r0,r1,c0,c1=rs[0],rs[1],cs[0],cs[1]
            for j in range(c0,c1+1):
                if g[r0][j]==0: out[r0][j]=cc
                if g[r1][j]==0: out[r1][j]=cc
            for i in range(r0,r1+1):
                if g[i][c0]==0: out[i][c0]=cc
                if g[i][c1]==0: out[i][c1]=cc
    return out
